# [BUG] frontend npm audit fails: js-yaml and @vitest/mocker need a major-version bump

## Bug
`npm audit --audit-level=moderate` in `frontend/lmdb` exits 1 with 4 findings (3 moderate, 1 high). Confirmed live on `develop` at commit c6e63c4 (2026-09-19):
- `js-yaml` 4.3.1, pulled by `eslint@8.57.1` and `@eslint/eslintrc`: GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh, high.
- `@vitest/mocker` 4.1.10 and `@vitest/coverage-v8` 4.1.10, pulled by `vitest@4.1.10`: GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9, moderate.

This is the "Dependency/security scan (#105, #131)" step of `.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml`, which runs on every push/PR touching `frontend/**`, so it currently fails CI end-to-end.

Found auditing story #124 / task #131 (#298): both closed 2026-08-09 with the tree clean; these two advisories were disclosed afterward.

## Root Cause
Both fixes require a major-version bump: `js-yaml` only patches this at `5.x` (current pin resolves to `4.3.1`, the top of the vulnerable range), and `vitest`/`@vitest/coverage-v8` only patch it at `5.x` (current pin `^4.1.10` resolves to `4.1.10`, also the top of the vulnerable range). `npm audit fix`, with or without `--package-lock-only`, fails on this repo with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` — an npm 10.9.7 arborist error, reproduced after a clean `node_modules` reinstall.

## Severity vs. Priority
**Severity (technical impact):** Major — blocks the frontend CI audit gate on every push/PR to `main`/`develop`. Both packages are dev-only tooling, not shipped in the production `dist/` build.
**Priority (business urgency):** P2

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` exits 0 in `frontend/lmdb` (`npm audit --audit-level=moderate`)
- [ ] `eslint` and `vitest`/`@vitest/coverage-v8` are on versions that resolve GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh and GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9, with `npm run lint`, `npm test -- --coverage` and `npm run build` still passing (`npm run lint`, `npm test -- --coverage`, `npm run build`)
- [ ] Frontend CI green end-to-end on a push to `develop` (`.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml`)
